voice: Concise diegetic reference establishing the names of legitimate benefit guests and museum staff.

entries.text: A tall, imposing gentleman guards the door in a severe military uniform. A leather-bound register rests on the podium beside him.

A leather-bound register lists Steve Dorian, Wolf Heimlich, Yvette Delacroix, Rameses Najeer, Countess Lavinia Waldorf-Carlton, Dr. Olympia Myklos, and Dr. Ptahsheptut 'Tut' Smith among the evening's guests and museum staff. Dr. Pippin Carter and Dr. Archibald Carrington III are also expected. Ziggy's name is conspicuously absent.
